verdict.rationale: Ultrametric says it "runs no model" and that work uses the customer's own AI plan, and that `--path` project context stays local during retrieval. That indirectly suggests Ultrametric itself is not a model operator training on user data. However, it hosts company records, and nothing in the evidence states a no-training policy or offers an opt-out control. Missing for 10: an explicit data-use/no-training policy covering hosted company records, a user-facing training opt-out or setting, any statement on sharing data with third parties for training, and independent corroboration.
